statements.t: Earnest, President and CEO of Vista Gold, stated, “During the third quarter, we maintained strong progress in advancing the Mt Todd gold project toward development.

If the Arrangement is not completed, the Company will continue to operate as an independent public company and will continue to seek to maximize shareholder value through advancement of its Mt Todd gold project.
